arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/worst2.py << 'EOF'
import json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from gen_big import gen_big

rng = random.Random(13)
cases = []
for _ in range(2):
    cases.append(gen_big(rng, J=512, S=256, F=32, G=32, wide=True))
sys.stdout.buffer.write(json.dumps({'version': 3, 'cases': cases}).encode())
EOF
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 tmp/worst2.py > tmp/worst2_req.json && time (LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 public_exec.py submission/main.py < tmp/worst2_req.json > tmp/worst2_out.json) && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 - << 'EOF'

out = json.load(open('tmp/worst2_out.json'))
for i, r in enumerate(out['results']):
